[EN] Has there been any news of the scouts? My husband's among them.
[ES] ¿Ha habido alguna noticia de los exploradores? Mi esposo está entre ellos.

[EN] Yes, Celtan. Are you here for the dagger you lent me? Do you have news of my husband?
[ES] Sí, Celtan. ¿Vienes por la daga que me prestaste? ¿Tienes noticias de mi esposo?

[EN] Oh, Celtan! Why did you have to send him?
[ES] ¡Oh, Celtan! ¿Por qué tuviste que enviarlo?

[EN] Darling, I won't forget you. No matter what...
[ES] Cariño, no te olvidaré. Pase lo que pase...
